notes.title: ANNOUNCEMENT
notes.content: We would like to thank you for playing FUNGI the last couple of years. Unfortunately the game has reached a standstill and can’t be sustained by our funds alone. This is why we've decided to close the server on October 1st. If you have an idea to keep the game online or know somebody interested to buy it, please email us at info@nonline.nl

notes.title: FUNGI is now available on Steam!
notes.content:
We're excited to announce FUNGI is now available on Steam! 

Packing new features for PC & Mac like the new Battle Royale mode, achievements, skins, action shortcuts, customizable controls and more…

Come join us in a fungi feeding frenzy!
